name: clawd-actor
description: While Claude works, Clawd acts out the spinner's -ing word above the prompt, and the tool that is running; it also keeps your notes, todos and reminders, and hands out badges

keepDays.title: Days /clawd clean keeps
keepDays.description: /clawd clean only clears finished lines older than this many days.

cleanHint.title: Old lines before /clawd list mentions cleaning
cleanHint.description: How many old finished lines pile up before /clawd list suggests /clawd clean. 0 never mentions it.

remindAhead.title: Minutes a reminder is called out ahead
remindAhead.description: Clawd honks this many minutes before a reminder, then again when it is due. 0 only calls it when due.

nudgeMinutes.title: Minutes between "next up" bubbles
nudgeMinutes.description: At a turn's start Clawd shows the next open todo at most this often. 0 turns it off.
